original_benchmark.notes: Coop setting (the benchmark default): two agents, one feature each, messaging on, shared git off; all 652 feature pairs of dataset/subsets/all.json (30 tasks, 12 repositories, 199 features). Agent versions are the CooperBench commit 63b9d44.

One agent implements both features of a pair. Served by the same 652 tasks: a single Harbor agent receives both features in instruction.md (the solo prompt layout with a short header). Not parity-tested as a separate setting.
Three-agent groups: team3_all (1409 groups over 29 tasks) and its 250-group subset team3_250. Out of scope; the adapter generates two-agent feature pairs only.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on a 15-pair subset (split parity: stratified by repository, seed 42), 3 runs per side: original 55.56 ± 8.01, Harbor 55.56 ± 5.88 (pass rate, %). Parity cost is an estimate from the token counts of all parity model calls (both sides, sanity runs, standard-agent run) at the model's list price. Oracle: 652/652. Standard agent: Claude Code 2.1.311 with the same model, 11/15 on the parity set (one run).
